queries.text: Why did Google acquire cloud-security firm Wiz in March 2025, and what did the deal signal about the cloud-security market?
Wiz acquisition price by Google in March 2025, USD
Google's stated strategic rationale for acquiring Wiz in official press releases or earnings calls from Q1-Q2 2025
Global cloud security market size forecast for 2030 and compound annual growth rate (CAGR) from major research firms like Gartner or IDC
